items.name: Run Away With Me
items.tagline: Just you, the mountains, and the best day of your life.
items.subtitle: All-Inclusive Elopement · Nothing Left to Arrange
items.left_body:
We handle absolutely everything so all you have to do is show up, look incredible, and say I do. No spreadsheets. No stress. Just magic.

#### The Experience

Your elopement is not a smaller wedding — it is a more intentional one. Every detail, every vendor, every moment is chosen specifically for the two of you.

We scout locations in the Canadian Rockies that match your vision — whether that's a wildflower meadow, a glacial lakeshore, a canyon, or a mountain summit. We handle permits, pack-in and pack-out logistics, and all vendor coordination. Leave No Trace is a value, not just a policy.

On your day, you simply arrive. We handle everything else.

items.image_alt: A fully styled reception ballroom with tall white floral arrangements
items.right_body:
#### What's Included

- Initial consultation and vision development — a bespoke concept built on your style, priorities and budget
- Full timeline and budget management — customized tracking, payment schedules and vendor contracts
- Venue sourcing and site visits — curated selection, virtual or on-site visits, and venue negotiations
- Vendor curation and management — florists, caterers, photographers, videographers, officiants, entertainment, hair and makeup, rentals, transportation
- Design, styling and décor — full creative direction including colour palette, florals, signage, linens and lighting
- Guest experience and logistics — travel guidance, welcome events, accommodation blocks and guest communication
- Ceremony and reception coordination — run-of-show, rehearsal, floor plan and vendor load-in oversight
- Day-of production team — lead planner, assistant planners and on-site vendor liaisons
- Legal and cultural guidance — destination marriage requirements, permits and translator coordination if needed
- 24/7 on-call support and contingency planning in the weeks leading up to your day
items.name: The Whole Gorgeous Thing
items.tagline: From the champagne when you said yes, to the last song of the night — we are with you for every single chapter. Your only job is to fall more in love.
items.subtitle: Full Planning · Start to Finish
items.left_body:
#### Why Choose Marry Me, In Banff

**Local expertise** — we partner with the region's most respected vendors to deliver authentic, elevated experiences.

**Turnkey service** — from concept to celebration, we provide a single point of contact and full-service execution.

**Attention to detail** — every timeline, contract and design decision is vetted and managed with precision.

**Guest-first approach** — we design logistics and experiences that prioritise comfort and memorable moments.

items.right_body:
#### What's Included

- Initial consultation and full plan review — one comprehensive meeting within 4–6 weeks of the wedding
- Preferred vendor list and recommendations for any remaining needs

- Rehearsal coordination — attendance and leadership at the wedding rehearsal
- Full day-of coordination (6 hours) — ceremony cues, music, timing, vendor transitions
- Ceremony and reception setup and styling oversight
- Breakdown and vendor load-out oversight
- Professional emergency kit — safety pins, stain remover, pain relief, bandages and more
items.name: We Got You, Babe
items.tagline: You've done the hard work. Now hand us the wand.

items.name: Just Say Yes
items.tagline: Show up, say it, celebrate. That's literally it.
items.subtitle: All the Essentials, No Fuss
items.left_body:
We take care of everything you need for the most important 20 minutes of your life. Simple. Beautiful. Completely yours.

#### The Experience

The Just Say Yes package is exactly what it sounds like — beautifully simple. No months of planning, no overwhelming vendor lists, no decisions to agonise over. We have hand-picked the essential vendors so you don't have to. Everything in this package is fixed, curated and ready to go.

You don't choose the photographer — we have one. You don't source the officiant — we have one. You don't find the ceremony location — we have that too. This is a straight-up, no-fuss ceremony package with everything you need and nothing you don't.

#### Want to Make It Yours?

Add what matters to you — a bridal bouquet, hair and makeup, a cake, a photographer upgrade, a venue rental, a celebratory dinner. We'll coordinate any add-ons seamlessly so everything still feels effortless on the day. Think of it as your foundation — everything essential is already in place, and the rest is entirely up to you.

items.question: How far in advance should we book?
items.answer: The Canadian Rockies are one of the world's most sought-after destination wedding locations, and peak season dates — June through September, long weekends, and holidays — fill up quickly. We recommend reaching out 12 months ahead for full-planning packages, and a minimum of 6 months for coordination-only services. That said, if your date is closer, please don't hesitate to enquire — we love a beautifully executed last-minute plan.

items.question: How do we officially secure our date?
items.answer: A signed contract and a 50% deposit confirm your date and take it off the market. Until both are received, the date remains available to other enquiries. We'll walk you through our contract clearly before you sign anything.

items.question: Do you take on more than one wedding per weekend?
items.answer: No. Once your date is booked, it's yours entirely. You have our full attention, our full team, and everything we've got — without distraction. That's a promise.

items.question: What's your cancellation and rescheduling policy?
items.answer: Life happens. Our cancellation policy is outlined in full in your contract and varies depending on how far in advance changes are made. We always try to work with couples during difficult circumstances — please reach out as soon as possible if anything changes.

items.question: What packages do you offer?
items.answer: We offer four packages designed for every kind of couple. Run Away With Me is our all-inclusive elopement package from $9,000 CAD. The Whole Gorgeous Thing is full planning from start to finish, from $7,000 CAD. We Got You, Babe sweeps in for the final weeks and full day-of coordination from $4,000 CAD. And Just Say Yes delivers all the essentials for a simple, beautiful ceremony from $3,500 CAD. Full details are above in our packages menu.

items.question: What does your pricing look like?
items.answer: Packages begin at $3,500 CAD. Full pricing is shared after an initial discovery call, as each wedding has its own scope, guest count, and complexity. You'll always receive a detailed proposal with no hidden fees before any commitment is made.

items.question: Do you require a deposit?
items.answer: Yes — a 50% non-refundable retainer is required to hold your date. The remaining balance is structured in instalments outlined in your contract. We accept Interac e-Transfer, credit card, and bank transfer.

items.question: Are there any additional fees we should know about?
items.answer: Our planning fee covers our time, expertise, and coordination. Vendor costs, venue hire, permits, accommodation, catering, florals, and all third-party expenses are separate and outlined clearly in your personalised budget. Travel fees may apply for weddings outside the Canmore/Banff corridor. We will always be upfront about what's included and what isn't.

items.question: What does full planning actually mean — what do you take off our plate?
items.answer: Everything. Venue sourcing and site visits, vendor research and booking, contract review, budget management, timeline creation, rehearsal coordination, floor plan design, styling and aesthetic direction, and full day-of execution. We are your single point of contact from the moment you book until the moment you drive away as newlyweds.

items.question: Do you offer floral design?
items.answer: Yes — with 17 years of floristry experience (including running Forget-Me-Not Flowers in Banff), florals are part of our DNA. We can design and source blooms in-house or work alongside your chosen florist. Ask us about combining floral design with your planning package.

items.question: What happens if something goes wrong on the day?
items.answer: We plan for everything so you don't have to. Our team carries a professional emergency kit (safety pins, stain remover, pain relief, bandages and more) and arrives with detailed contingency plans for weather, vendor delays, and the unexpected. We've seen it all — and we handle it quietly so you never have to.

items.question: Do you have a preferred vendor list?
items.answer: After 17 years working in the Banff and Canmore wedding industry, we've cultivated deep relationships with the best photographers, videographers, florists, caterers, musicians, hair and makeup artists, and officiants in the region. Our preferred vendors are chosen for their talent, reliability, and shared commitment to excellence. We're always happy to share our recommendations.

items.question: Can we bring our own vendors?
items.answer: Absolutely. You're welcome to work with vendors of your choosing, and we'll integrate them seamlessly into your day. We do ask that all vendors hold appropriate licensing and liability insurance, and are informed of venue and permit requirements. We'll handle all vendor communication once they're confirmed.

items.question: Which venues do you work with?
items.answer: We have strong relationships with venues across the Bow Valley, including the Fairmont Banff Springs, The Banff Centre, Silvertip Resort, Banff Hospitality Collective (BHC), The Malcolm Hotel, various Parks Canada–approved outdoor locations, and intimate private properties. We're also experienced with non-traditional settings — alpine meadows, lakeshores, canyon viewpoints, and mountain summits.

items.question: Can you help with florals, or do we need to hire a separate florist?
items.answer: We can do both. With a background running a full-service floristry studio in Banff, we offer in-house floral design as part of select packages. If you've already booked a florist, we'll work beautifully alongside them. Either way, the florals will be extraordinary.

items.question: We're travelling from overseas — can you manage everything remotely?
items.answer: Yes, and we do it all the time. The majority of our couples are destination clients, many of them international. We're fluent in planning across time zones via video calls and detailed digital planning tools. When you arrive, your job is to enjoy every moment — not to manage logistics.

items.question: Do you need a permit to get married in Banff National Park?
items.answer: Yes. Any commercial event in a National Park — including weddings — requires a Commercial Use Licence and a filming/event permit from Parks Canada. Popular locations like Lake Louise, Johnston Canyon, and Moraine Lake have strict booking windows and capacity limits. We handle the entire permit process on your behalf, including scouting approved sites that will genuinely take your breath away.

items.question: What about weddings outside Banff — Canmore, Kananaskis, or beyond?
items.answer: Canmore is our home base and we know every corner of the Bow Valley, Kananaskis Country, and into Yoho and Jasper National Parks. We also work seasonally in Hawaii and Australia — enquire if you're planning a destination wedding in either location.

items.question: What's the best time of year to get married in the Rockies?
items.answer: Every season is spectacular for different reasons. Peak summer (late June to early September) offers warm, long days and reliable outdoor conditions. Autumn brings the golden larch season in September and October — one of the most sought-after times to be married here. Winter delivers dramatic snowy backdrops and an intimate, exclusive atmosphere. Spring can be unpredictable but utterly magical. We'll guide you through every seasonal consideration for your chosen date.

items.question: Do you work with eloping couples and small ceremonies?
items.answer: It's one of our greatest loves. We offer two dedicated elopement packages — Run Away With Me and Just Say Yes — and we've guided hundreds of couples through intimate ceremonies in some of the most extraordinary locations on earth. Small doesn't mean simple. It means intentional.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Fill out the inquiry form on our website and we'll be in touch within 48 hours to schedule a discovery call. This is a relaxed, no-pressure conversation where we hear all about your vision, answer your questions, and explore how we can work together. We only take on a limited number of weddings each year, so we like to make sure it's the right fit on both sides.

items.question: What if we don't have a clear vision yet?
items.answer: That's actually our favourite starting point. Helping couples discover and articulate their vision is one of the most exciting parts of what we do. Bring your feelings, your references, your 'I don't knows' — we'll help you find the thread and pull it into something extraordinary.

items.question: Will you be our planner on the day, or do you hand off to someone else?
items.answer: You'll have direct continuity with us throughout your entire planning journey and on your wedding day. We don't hand you off to a junior coordinator at the finish line. The team who planned your wedding will be there to see it through.

items.question: Do you plan weddings outside of Alberta?
items.answer: Yes. In addition to our home base in Canmore, we work seasonally in Hawaii and Australia. International enquiries are always welcome — we love a well-travelled love story.

sections.body:
With over 17 years of experience in the wedding and event industry, Lorelle is a true local expert in Banff and Canmore. Specializing in designing and curating personalized events, she brings a unique touch to every occasion.

Having owned and operated a floral and décor business in Banff, Lorelle combines her design background with her extensive experience as a wedding coordinator for various companies. Her passion for creating unforgettable experiences shines through in every event she touches.
